headline: Network vantage fusion: no current finding
dek: The source is stale. Palimpsest keeps the availability and evidence record visible without publishing retained values as current news.

claims.statement: No current finding is published for Network vantage fusion because the source status is stale.

method.summary: coverage-weighted mean of vantages normalized to 0-100 (Censored Planet remote interference rate, OONI in-country anomaly index); agreement = 1 − |OONI − CP| / 60pp; CONTESTED when the two differ > 20pp; net4people blocking-event share adjusts confidence only.

limitations: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed
The fused index summarizes differently sampled methods and is not a direct percentage of China's internet traffic.
